name: next-stepper
summary: Multi-step form component for Next.js with conditional steps, progress tracking and Zustand state.
description: A dynamic multi-step form built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Framer Motion. Steps can be filtered by earlier answers, transitions and progress are animated, state is kept in Zustand, and the component ships with optional step icons, images and a completion summary.
contains: dynamic multi-step navigation with progress tracking
conditional step filtering based on previous selections
Framer Motion transitions and Zustand state
optional icons and images per step, completion summary
